title: Bonjour TXT record
description: TXT keys of the hub's mDNS announcement. All values are strings. Clients must ignore unknown keys.

app_url.description: Only when an App URL is configured.

tls.description: Only when a TLS certificate exists (also when tls_enabled is false).

version.description: Hub version (e.g. 2026.12.0). Informational; compatibility is decided by pv.

iid.description: Stable hub instance id; two hubs in one LAN are distinguishable.

pv.description: protocol_version of the hub as a decimal string.

pv_min.description: min_protocol_version of the hub as a decimal string. An app below it shows 'update the app' before pairing.
